text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I saw Special Week on her way 
to school, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Gotta think more... about 
positioning... mumble mumble.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
――Hah!! Huh...? The race was... just a 
dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, my head's completely full of racing 
thoughts... I ended up staying up late 
again... *yawn*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week might not be getting enough 
sleep. I'll need to keep an eye on her 
too.
